reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Kansas
    focus_year: 2021

    Question: Does state/territory eviction law explicitly regulate residential landlords generally?

    We encode the provided statutes as definitional predicates and then reason whether Kansas
    has an eviction-related residential landlord/tenant law that explicitly regulates landlords
    generally (i.e., not limited only to a special housing subtype like mobile home parks).
*/

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Scenario facts (the question's factual statement)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

scenario_state(kansas).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario described by the question is active. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(kansas),
    scenario_focus_year(2021).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Statute translations (definitions only, as provided)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/*
  KS Stat  58-25,103 (2021) - Mobile Home Parks Residential Landlord/Tenant definitions
  We model only the parts needed to determine scope (mobile home park-specific).
*/

% statute_58_25_103_landlord_definition_applies_to_mobile_home_park_landlords(Year).
statute_58_25_103_landlord_definition_applies_to_mobile_home_park_landlords(2021) :- !.

% statute_58_25_103_landlord_type(Year, landlord_role).
% "Landlord" means the owner/lessor/sublessor of a mobile home park; also certain managers.
statute_58_25_103_landlord_type(2021, owner_lessor_sublessor_of_mobile_home_park) :- !.
statute_58_25_103_landlord_type(2021, manager_of_mobile_home_park_who_fails_to_disclose) :- !.

/*
  KS Stat  58-2543 (2021) - Kansas Residential Landlord and Tenant Act (KRLTA) definitions
  Key points:
  - "Action" includes an action for possession (eviction context).
  - "Dwelling unit" is broadly a home/residence/sleeping place, with certain exclusions.
  - "Landlord" includes owner/lessor/sublessor of dwelling unit/building; also certain managers.
*/

% statute_58_2543_action_includes_possession(Year).
% (a) "Action" includes ... including an action for possession.
statute_58_2543_action_includes_possession(2021) :- !.

% statute_58_2543_dwelling_unit_general_residential_meaning(Year).
% (c) "Dwelling unit" means a structure/part of structure used as a home/residence/sleeping place...
statute_58_2543_dwelling_unit_general_residential_meaning(2021) :- !.

% statute_58_2543_dwelling_unit_exclusion_manufactured_or_mobile_home_unless_rented(Year).
% ... shall not include real property used to accommodate a manufactured home or mobile home,
% unless such manufactured home/mobile home is rented or leased by the landlord.
statute_58_2543_dwelling_unit_exclusion_manufactured_or_mobile_home_unless_rented(2021) :- !.

% statute_58_2543_landlord_general_definition(Year).
% (e) "Landlord" means the owner/lessor/sublessor of the dwelling unit/building part, and certain managers.
statute_58_2543_landlord_general_definition(2021) :- !.

% statute_58_2543_landlord_type(Year, landlord_role).
statute_58_2543_landlord_type(2021, owner_lessor_sublessor_of_dwelling_unit_or_building) :- !.
statute_58_2543_landlord_type(2021, manager_of_premises_who_fails_to_disclose) :- !.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Legal reasoning helpers
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/* Kansas has an eviction-related legal context if the act defines "action" to include possession. */
legal_eviction_context_defined(State, Year) :-
    State = kansas,
    statute_58_2543_action_includes_possession(Year).

/* The statute regulates "residential landlords generally" if it defines "dwelling unit" broadly
   as a home/residence/sleeping place and defines "landlord" as owner/lessor/sublessor of such units.
   This is broader than a narrow niche (e.g., only mobile home parks). */
legal_residential_landlord_regulated_generally(State, Year) :-
    State = kansas,
    statute_58_2543_dwelling_unit_general_residential_meaning(Year),
    statute_58_2543_landlord_general_definition(Year).

/* This predicate answers the question's legal test for the scenario:
   "Does eviction law explicitly regulate residential landlords generally?" */
legal_question_answer_yes(State, Year) :-
    legal_eviction_context_defined(State, Year),
    legal_residential_landlord_regulated_generally(State, Year).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Final answer predicate (deterministic yes/no)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    legal_question_answer_yes(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does state/territory eviction law explicitly regulate residential landlords generally?
